title: 有向图判环 III
description: 给定一张有向图，判断图中是否存在环。存在环输出 `YES`，否则输出 `NO`。
hint: 拓扑排序能访问到的节点数少于 $n$ 就说明有环。

solutions.python:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(data[0])
m = int(data[1])
edges = [tuple(map(int, data[2 + i * 2:4 + i * 2])) for i in range(m)]
from collections import deque
adj = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
indeg = [0] * (n + 1)
for u, v in edges:
    adj[u].append(v)
    indeg[v] += 1
dq = deque([i for i in range(1, n + 1) if indeg[i] == 0])
seen = 0
while dq:
    u = dq.popleft()
    seen += 1
    for v in adj[u]:
        indeg[v] -= 1
        if indeg[v] == 0:
            dq.append(v)
print("YES" if seen < n else "NO")
